name: Mine Protection
author: SCUMSA
description: Punishes players who arm a mine or trap OUTSIDE their (or their squad's) flag area — teleports them onto their own armed mine. Squad-aware: a squadmate arming inside another member's flag is never punished. State survives restarts. Configure everything from its admin tab: watched classes, extra margin, action (teleport-to-mine or warn-only), first-offence warning, online requirement and exemptions.
